**ITSA-UPSA WEBSITE**  
**Production Technical Documentation**  
_Information Technology Students Association — University of Professional Studies, Accra_  
Document Version: 1.0 | Status: Ready for Development  
MVP Scope: Public Website + Single-Role Admin CMS

**1\. Project Overview**
========================

This document specifies the production build of the official website for the Information Technology Students Association (ITSA) at the University of Professional Studies, Accra (UPSA). The site serves two audiences: the general public/student body, who browse freely without needing an account, and a single Admin role (the ITSA executive body, operating one shared administrative account) who publishes and manages all content through a CMS.

**1.1 Goals**
-------------

*   Give ITSA a professional public presence that reflects the association's brand and mission.
*   Centralise department news, events, and the president's communications in one place.
*   Host recorded tutorial lectures for IT students to learn at their own pace.
*   Provide a searchable bank of lecture slides and past examination questions.
*   Track department activities — past and upcoming — in a simple public timeline.
*   Introduce the department, its authorities, and the ITSA executives to visitors and new students.

**1.2 MVP Scope Decisions**
---------------------------

**Visitor authentication:** None. All public pages, tutorial videos, and Academic Bank downloads are open to any visitor — no sign-up or login required.  
**Content management:** A single Admin role, protected by login, has full CMS access to publish and manage everything (news, events, tutorials, academic resources, About page content). No multi-role executive hierarchy in the MVP — see Section 9 for a phased path to that.  
**Payments:** Not required for MVP — the site is informational/educational, not transactional.  
**Primary platform:** Responsive web application, desktop and mobile browsers.

**2\. Brand & Design System**
=============================

All colours are drawn directly from the ITSA-UPSA crest so the website feels like a natural extension of the association's existing identity: deep navy-purple as the dominant brand colour, gold for emblem/accent detailing, and white/off-white for contrast and readability.

**2.1 Colour Palette**
----------------------

| **Token** | **Hex** | **Usage** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Primary / Navy | #200C4B | Header, footer, nav bar, primary buttons, headings |
| Primary Dark | #170933 | Hover states, dark section backgrounds |
| Accent / Gold | #C7B50D | Icons, dividers, highlights, badges, links on dark backgrounds |
| Gold Light | #E8DE7A | Hover accents, subtle highlight backgrounds |
| Surface White | #FFFFFF | Card backgrounds, primary page background |
| Off-White | #F7F7F7 | Section alternation background, page base |
| Text Grey | #5B5B66 | Body copy, secondary text, captions |

**2.2 Typography**
------------------

**Headings:** Cambria (serif) — echoes the formal, institutional tone of the crest lettering  
**Body / UI:** Inter or Calibri (sans-serif) — clean and highly legible for tutorials/text-heavy pages  
**Scale:** H1 32–40px · H2 24–28px · H3 18–20px · Body 16px · Caption 13px

**2.3 Logo Usage**
------------------

*   Primary logo (full colour crest) used in the site header and footer.
*   On navy backgrounds, keep the full-colour crest as-is — it already reads well against dark surfaces.
*   Maintain circular clear space around the crest equal to 10% of its diameter.
*   Favicon: a simplified, flattened version of the crest (monitor/code icon on navy).

**2.4 Visual Language**
-----------------------

*   Rounded cards (8–12px radius) with soft shadows for events, tutorials, and resource listings.
*   Gold used sparingly as an accent — never as a full-page background — to avoid visual fatigue.
*   Iconography follows the crest's tech motifs: circuit/network lines, code brackets, monitor/tower shapes.

**3\. Information Architecture**
================================

**3.1 Public Sitemap**
----------------------

*   Home (/)
    *   Tutorials (/tutorials, /tutorials/\[slug\])
    *   Academic Bank (/academic-bank)
    *   Activities (/activities, /activities/\[slug\])
    *   About (/about)

**3.2 Admin Area (not publicly linked)**
----------------------------------------

*   /admin/login
    *   /admin/dashboard
    *   /admin/home-content — banner, president's speech, news
    *   /admin/tutorials — upload/manage videos
    *   /admin/academic-bank — upload/manage slides & past questions
    *   /admin/activities — create/manage activities
    *   /admin/about — edit department & executives content

**3.3 Global Navigation**
-------------------------

Sticky top navigation on navy background: Home · Tutorials · Academic Bank · Activities · About, with the ITSA crest on the left. Footer repeats key links plus social media icons and a subtle 'Admin' link (icon only) for executives.

**4\. Feature Specifications**
==============================

**4.1 Home**
------------

The landing page and first impression of ITSA — a snapshot of who the association is and what's happening right now.

### **Hero Banner**

*   Full-width hero with rotating banner images/announcements (max 5, admin-managed carousel)
*   ITSA crest + tagline overlay (e.g. 'Empowering Innovations')
*   Primary call-to-action buttons: 'Explore Tutorials' and 'View Activities'

### **Featured Events & Activities**

*   Card grid pulling the 3–6 most recent/upcoming items from the Activities module
*   Each card: image, title, date, short excerpt, 'Read more' link to activity detail page
*   'View All Activities' link to the full Activities page

### **President's Speech**

*   Dedicated welcome section with the President's photo, name, title, and a written address
*   Rich-text field (admin-editable) supporting paragraphs, bold/italic, and an optional embedded video message

### **Latest News & Updates**

*   Chronological list/grid of short news posts (title, date, summary, optional image)
*   Admin can publish/unpublish and schedule a future publish date
*   Pagination or 'Load more' after the first 6 items

**4.2 Tutorials**
-----------------

A public video library of recorded lecture tutorials, organised for easy browsing and self-paced study.

### **Listing Page**

*   Grid of tutorial cards: thumbnail, title, course/category tag, uploader, duration, upload date
*   Filter by course/category and search by title or lecturer
*   Sort by newest, most-viewed, or alphabetical

### **Tutorial Detail Page**

*   Embedded video player (Cloudinary-hosted, adaptive streaming)
*   Title, description, associated course/level, lecturer/presenter credit
*   View counter and optional 'related tutorials' section

### **Admin Capabilities**

*   Upload video (direct upload to Cloudinary with signed upload, progress bar)
*   Set title, description, course/category, level (100–400), tags, and thumbnail
*   Edit, unpublish, or delete existing tutorials

**4.3 Academic Bank**
---------------------

A repository of lecture slides and past examination questions, organised by course and level for quick discovery.

### **Listing & Filtering**

*   Filter by resource type (Slides / Past Questions), course, level, and academic year
*   Search by course name or code
*   Each entry shows: title, course, level, file type/size, upload date, download count

### **Download Experience**

*   Direct download or preview-in-browser (PDF/PPTX rendered via Cloudinary or a preview viewer)
*   No login required to download — public resource

### **Admin Capabilities**

*   Bulk or single file upload (PDF, DOCX, PPTX) to Cloudinary with organised folder structure per course
*   Tag each upload with course, level, semester/year, and resource type
*   Edit metadata, replace files, or remove outdated resources

**4.4 Activities**
------------------

A public record of what the department has done and what's coming up — workshops, hackathons, socials, general meetings, and outreach.

### **Listing Page**

*   Two clearly separated views/tabs: 'Upcoming' and 'Past Activities'
*   Each card: cover image, title, date, venue, short description, status badge
*   Filter/sort by date

### **Activity Detail Page**

*   Full description, image gallery for past events, date/time/venue for upcoming ones
*   Optional RSVP/interest link (external form, e.g. Google Form) for upcoming activities

### **Admin Capabilities**

*   Create/edit activities with title, description, date range, venue, cover image, gallery images
*   Mark status automatically (Upcoming vs Past) based on date, with manual override

**4.5 About Department**
------------------------

Introduces the Department of Information Technology Education and the ITSA executive team.

### **Department Overview**

*   Brief written description of the department: mission, programmes offered, vision
*   Department authorities: Head of Department and lecturers, with name, title, and optional photo

### **ITSA Executives**

*   Grid of executive profile cards: photo, full name, position (President, Vice President, PRO, Financial Secretary, etc.), short bio
*   Optional links to LinkedIn/social profiles per executive

### **Admin Capabilities**

*   Edit department description and authorities list
*   Add, edit, reorder, or remove executive profile cards

**4.6 Admin CMS**
-----------------

A single protected Admin role with full publishing control over every public page listed above. No multi-tier executive roles in the MVP — one shared, securely-authenticated Admin account is sufficient for launch.

### **Authentication**

*   Supabase Auth (email + password) restricted to pre-provisioned admin account(s) — no public sign-up route
*   Session-protected /admin/\* routes via Next.js middleware; unauthenticated access redirects to /admin/login

### **Dashboard**

*   At-a-glance counts: published news, upcoming activities, total tutorials, total academic resources
*   Quick-action shortcuts to each content module

### **Content Modules**

*   Home content: banner slides, president's speech, news posts
*   Tutorials: upload, edit, delete
*   Academic Bank: upload, edit, delete
*   Activities: create, edit, delete, status control
*   About: department text + executives roster

**5\. Technology Stack**
========================

Consistent with the shared architecture used across your other Ghana-focused platforms — a unified Next.js 14 stack keeps this build fast to ship and easy to maintain alongside your existing projects.

| **Layer** | **Technology** | **Purpose** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Frontend Framework | Next.js 14 (App Router) | Public pages + admin dashboard in one codebase, SSG/ISR for fast public pages |
| Language | TypeScript | Type safety across frontend, admin, and API routes |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS | Utility-first styling matched to the brand palette |
| UI Components | shadcn/ui | Accessible primitives for forms, tables, dialogs in the admin CMS |
| Auth | Supabase Auth | Email/password login restricted to the Admin account |
| Database | Supabase (PostgreSQL) | News, tutorials, academic resources, activities, executives — with Row-Level Security |
| Media Storage | Cloudinary | Video hosting/streaming for tutorials; file storage for slides & past questions; image optimisation |
| Email | Resend | Admin notifications (e.g. new upload confirmation) — optional for MVP |
| Deployment | Vercel | Hosting, previews, CI/CD on every push |
| Rate Limiting | Upstash Redis | Protects public download/search endpoints from abuse |
| Bot Protection | Arcjet | Guards the admin login route from brute-force attempts |

**7\. Application Route Structure**
===================================

Next.js 14 App Router layout, cleanly separating public pages from the protected admin namespace.  
app/  
(public)/  
page.tsx → Home  
tutorials/page.tsx → Tutorials listing  
tutorials/\[slug\]/page.tsx → Tutorial detail  
academic-bank/page.tsx → Academic Bank listing  
activities/page.tsx → Activities listing  
activities/\[slug\]/page.tsx → Activity detail  
about/page.tsx → About Department  
admin/  
login/page.tsx  
dashboard/page.tsx  
home-content/page.tsx  
tutorials/page.tsx  
academic-bank/page.tsx  
activities/page.tsx  
about/page.tsx  
api/  
upload/route.ts → Signed Cloudinary upload endpoint  
revalidate/route.ts → ISR revalidation webhook  
middleware.ts → Protects /admin/\* routes

**8\. Non-Functional Requirements**
===================================

**8.1 Performance**
-------------------

*   Public pages statically generated (SSG) or ISR-revalidated on content change — target Lighthouse score 90+.
*   Images served via Cloudinary auto-format/auto-quality; video adaptive bitrate streaming.

**8.2 Security**
----------------

*   Admin routes protected by Supabase Auth session + Next.js middleware; no public registration endpoint.
*   Row-Level Security policies: public read access on published content, write access restricted to authenticated admin.
*   Arcjet bot/brute-force protection on the /admin/login route.
*   All file uploads validated for type and size before reaching Cloudinary (signed uploads only).

**8.3 SEO & Accessibility**
---------------------------

*   Semantic HTML, descriptive meta tags and Open Graph images per page for social sharing.
*   Sitemap.xml and robots.txt generated automatically.
*   WCAG 2.1 AA colour contrast maintained even with the gold-on-navy accent combinations.

**8.4 Responsiveness**
----------------------

*   Mobile-first layouts; tutorial player and Academic Bank filters fully usable on small screens.

**9\. Excluded From MVP — Future Phases**
=========================================

Deliberately out of scope for this launch, to keep the build lean and shippable. Documented here so they can be layered on later without re-architecting the core.

*   Multi-role executive access (President, PRO, Academic Officer, Financial Secretary each with scoped permissions) — MVP uses a single shared Admin role.
*   Student accounts / personalised dashboards (e.g. saved tutorials, download history).
*   Comments or discussion threads on tutorials and news posts.
*   Push notifications or email digests for new uploads.
*   Payment integration (e.g. dues collection via Paystack) — not needed while the site remains purely informational.
*   Full-text search across tutorials and Academic Bank using a dedicated search engine (Meilisearch/Typesense) — MVP uses simple filter/query search.
*   Analytics dashboard for the Admin beyond basic view/download counters.
